ui_skins:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Asset type: restored reusable UI skins extracted from the supplied Soft Miniature game demo screenshots.
The inputs are the actual approved UI screenshots. Extract/reconstruct ONLY their underlying empty UI surfaces, removing all baked-in words, numbers, icons, badges and foreground artwork. Preserve the screenshot's distinctive dimensional soft plastic edge profiles, warm ivory face, restrained 3D shadows, blue section bars and orange raised action buttons. This is restoration of source UI components, not a new design. Crisp clean high-resolution cutouts ready for game production.
Output one transparent PNG sheet in EXACTLY THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows (twelve cells total), portrait 3:4 aspect ratio if possible. One clean centered surface per cell, at least10% transparent padding on ALL sides, NO overlaps. All corners complete. No labels, text, numbers, symbols, icons, watermarks, checkered motifs or ornaments. Keep every center blank and smooth for dynamic UI text and nine-slice stretching.
Row1: orange raised wide action button from upgrade rows; pale blue wide secondary button matching source; gray disabled wide button.
Row2: warm ivory wide upgrade panel card with rounded corners; warm ivory tall inventory card; same tall inventory card with gold selected border.
Row3: blue wide section ribbon with rounded ends and no icon/text/pattern; blue bottom navigation tray; deep blue resource HUD pill with empty center.
Row4: mint green wide stat badge; pale blue wide stat badge; ivory wide segmented control tray without dividers.
Wide buttons/badges/ribbons approximate3:1 aspect ratio, widecard2:1, tallcards4:5. Identical upper-left light direction throughout. Truly transparent outside each component, retain only small contact shadow. Remove every baked-in character/icon from source surfaces. Do not include a phone or screenshots.

scenes.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact racing demo crop into a clean reusable 2D game background. Preserve its identical camera, miniature island silhouette, road loop geometry, red/cream curbs, ticket booth, grandstand crowd, garage, water, palms, lighthouse, cranes and parked cars. Remove ALL floating UI: left leaderboard panel, P3/8 player bubble and triangle, bottom-right lap capsule, every coin-income bubble including partially clipped ones at top, and any top green interface fragment. Remove the FOUR moving racecars on the asphalt (blue, red, yellow, green, purple if present), reconstructing the same asphalt and white dashed center markings beneath them. Keep the parked cars in the parking lot. Remove the lettering on the overhead start gate and ticket kiosk so the scene has no baked-in text, leave their physical signs blank. Repair only the occluded pixels, do not redesign or recompose. Output a clean opaque landscape PNG approximately twice the input resolution with crisp detail, anti-aliased clay edges and preserved soft lighting. No added text, objects, UI or frames.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact Soft Miniature garage scene crop into a reusable empty showroom background. Remove ONLY the large cream/orange racecar and its cast shadow from the circular display pedestal. Reconstruct the blue top of that same pedestal and the wall/floor where the car was. Preserve the exact camera angle, composition, pedestal rim and checker detail, soft cream workshop niche, lights, flags, tools, drawers, tires, trophy, bottles and plant. No other changes. Increase output resolution to approximately 2x the input with clean sharp clay/plastic detail, retain soft warm lighting. Opaque landscape PNG, no text, no vehicle, no new objects or UI.
